name: itinerary-hanoi-hue-hoi-an
description: Live /v1/chat answer for a multi-stop trip turn, captured as the quality target for itinerary answers. Seeded user: six saves along the route, a taste profile, and curated claims per place and city. What must hold: stop-by-stop structure in trip order, saves pinned to their city with insider notes spent, an on-the-way call-out for a city the user never named, the leg treated as part of the trip, and exactly one closing question (trip nights).

request.message: im doing hanoi, then hue, then hoi an — what should i stop at along the way?

seed.claims: 5 place claims + 4 area claims (curated_expert), see ADR-148 verification

response.message:
you've got a solid route already saved. here's how to run it:

[hanoi](kebi://area/vn/hanoi)

[Railway Tuan](kebi://venue/939ba8f5-e83b-4e64-9d3b-b1eeb00b096b) Cafe in the old quarter is the move. cozy spot with morning light, go early before the heat hits and you head south. if you're sticking around longer, the 7pm train is worth waiting for, but for a pass-through, coffee and the vibe is enough.

hue

[Quán Hạnh](kebi://venue/a3c3ca18-4041-4188-ad8d-9cf52df669bb) for traditional banh loc. cash only, and the banh loc runs out by early evening so hit it before 6. that's the whole reason to be there.

the leg between hue and hoi an

this is where your route gets interesting. [Bếp](kebi://venue/a853b835-5e9a-4169-a9ad-c4aa1c4175f4) Hiền sits on the drive between the cities, it closes between services around 2 to 5pm, so plan lunch or dinner around that gap. if you want to stop for sunset and a drink, [Kalà Kalà Beach Club](kebi://venue/a5a27bb2-d0ec-4b33-81a9-cb3baa1b9dc4) is on the way and daybeds book out on weekends, so a weekday at 4pm is yours to grab.

[Motorvina Da Nang](kebi://venue/4892f6da-ab37-4df0-b4a7-a2b7e244ca98) is also on this leg if you want to tackle the Hai Van Pass properly on a one-way rental.

hoi an

[Roving Chill house](kebi://venue/743de441-cdee-4166-80a5-576215e31bcc) first, before 10 in the morning when the rice paddy light is good and tour groups haven't landed yet. then [Nữ Eatery](kebi://venue/1965297d-4ab1-49a9-9084-723c9909d2ce) for a casual lunch or brunch vibe, same street over.

how many nights are you spending in each city? that changes what else is worth your time once you've eaten.
